lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Ho4 (reduced formula SrHo) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 38), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ho and Sr centers adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors, where Ho is coordinated by 8 Ho and 4 Sr, and Sr by 4 Ho and 8 Sr, at distances of 3.42–3.64 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing among 12-vertex Ho and Sr coordination polyhedra, including edge sharing between Ho–Ho, Sr–Sr, and Ho–Sr pairs.
